comment: The refresh workflow's NEON watch compares the live product metadata with this file: a change-log id not listed here, or a release not listed here, is reported for review. helpers.R NEON_RELEASE_DOI must list the same releases, and every NEON_DATA_NOTES change-log id must appear here with a matching *-note disposition (tests/test_neon_product_watch.R).

changelog.note: Table restructure to swc_externalLabDataByAnalyte; the producer reads that table.
Seepage-lake inlet and outlet sampling ended by 2018; pre-2018 dates at the six lakes average 2.93 replicates vs 1.44 after.
ANC sampling cut to monthly in 2018.
COVID-19 reduced sampling, March 2020 through 2021.
Field-table sample fields; not ingested.
TPC/TPN lab change and EcoCore milligram to microgramsPerLiter conversion; residual milligram identities are quarantined by the unit contract.
External lab stopped TSS dry mass and lab specific conductance; bundle values end 2020-03-19.
2019-07-01 nutrient method change; the STL and two-site charts mark it.
2011 prototype data; the bundle starts 2012-01-31.
Suspect Na and Ca, 2020-05 to 2022-06, removed and re-run by NEON.
SYCA study reach moved upstream on 2022-01-26.
Since spring 2022 a non-detect has a blank concentration and ND; the v5 producer keeps those rows.
OKSR and TOOK reduced sampling, 2020-03-23 to 2022-12-31.
BLDE flood closure 2022-06-12 to 2022-10-31; 0 bundle dates in the window.

Wrong TPC/TPN filters at FLNT, BARC, SUGG, 2023-08 to 2024-12; NEON removed the affected sample class. The 108 remaining in-window rows are single replicates (others average 2.1); brooke confirms with laboratoryName on a tokened pull.
WALK DOC 2018-06-19 to 2021-07-13; 0 bundle rows in the window.
LECO DOC 2019-09-25 to 2021-05-20; 0 bundle rows in the window.
HCO3 and CO3 erroneous; not in the bundle (the carbonate preset now uses DIC and ANC).
External-lab pH; not in the bundle.
High TSS 2020-01 to 2020-04; 0 bundle rows in the window.
Field blanks packaged with site downloads 2023-09 to 2026-01; the producer reports blank-like sample IDs in its fetch receipt.
USGS_NWQA Fe and Mn in microgramsPerLiter labelled milligramsPerLiter; the v5 value quarantine excludes the 102 identities.
REDB ALK and ANC 2024-08-13 to 2026-05-26 erroneous; the bundle's ANC is external-lab and ends 2020-03-19, and ALK is not ingested.
